name: Teddy Wright
credentials: Computer Science (AI emphasis) major and Economics minor at the University of Utah, expected Apr 2028. Pursuing a career in AI governance research.
blurb: Writings here span how AI is reshaping the information landscape, how we form beliefs and make decisions, why education needs a heavy overhaul now that AI exists, how to characterize the behavior of LLMs and define them better, and detailed measurement of how work across tasks is shifting as AI takes over what it holds comparative advantage in — writing, art, coding.
